mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.is_archived AS archived, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Operational' ELSE e.status END AS status, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE LPAD(e.id, 3, '0') END AS event, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.id END AS eventId, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.status_number END AS statusNumber, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(e.updated_date, c.updated_date), '%b %e, %Y, %l:%i %p') AS updated, COALESCE(e.notes, 'Operating normally.') AS note, NULLIF(e.admin_notes, '') AS admin FROM status_management_category c LEFT JOIN status_management_event e ON e.id = ( SELECT e1.id FROM status_management_event e1 WHERE e1.id_category = c.id ORDER BY e1.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.is_archived = #{archived} ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.is_archived AS archived, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN 'Operational' ELSE e.status END AS status, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE LPAD(e.id, 3, '0') END AS event, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.id END AS eventId, CASE WHEN e.id IS NULL OR e.closed_date IS NOT NULL THEN NULL ELSE e.status_number END AS statusNumber, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(e.updated_date, c.updated_date), '%b %e, %Y, %l:%i %p') AS updated, COALESCE(e.notes, 'Operating normally.') AS note, NULLIF(e.admin_notes, '') AS admin FROM status_management_category c LEFT JOIN status_management_event e ON e.id = ( SELECT e1.id FROM status_management_event e1 WHERE e1.id_category = c.id ORDER BY e1.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE c.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM status_management_category WHERE name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO status_management_category(name, is_archived, created_date, updated_date) VALUES(#{name}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM status_management_category WHERE id = #{id} AND is_archived = 1
mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.id_category AS idCategory, e.status, e.notes, e.admin_notes AS adminNotes, e.updated_by AS updatedBy, e.status_number AS statusNumber FROM status_management_event e INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category WHERE c.id = #{idCategory} AND e.closed_date IS NULL ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT e.id, e.id_category AS idCategory, e.status, e.notes, e.admin_notes AS adminNotes, e.updated_by AS updatedBy, e.status_number AS statusNumber FROM status_management_event e INNER JOIN status_management_category c ON c.id = e.id_category WHERE e.id = #{id} AND e.closed_date IS NULL AND c.is_archived = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT status_number FROM status_management_event ORDER BY updated_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE status_management_event SET status = #{status}, notes = #{notes}, admin_notes = #{adminNotes}, status_number = #{statusNumber}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND closed_date IS NULL

UPDATE status_management_event SET status = 'Operational', notes = #{notes}, admin_notes = #{adminNotes}, status_number = #{statusNumber}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_date = NOW(), closed_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND closed_date IS NULL
